title: Wuyue
capsule: Wuyue was one of the Ten Kingdoms of the Five Dynasties period, founded by Qian Liu in 907 after the collapse of the Tang dynasty, and centered on the lower Yangtze delta with its capital at Hangzhou (then called Xifu). The Qian rulers adopted a pragmatic strategy of avoiding warfare, maintaining tributary relations with successive northern dynasties, and investing in hydraulic engineering — dike systems they built shaped the Jiangnan agricultural landscape for centuries. The last ruler, Qian Chu, voluntarily surrendered the kingdom to the Song in 978 without military conflict, earning him the epithet 'the king who saved lives'; the Wuyue territory became the economic core of the early Song empire.
